html:
A northern rebel leader who took power in Chad in June 1982 and ruled until Idriss Deby overthrew him in December 1990.

Backed by France and the United States against Libya, he won the Toyota War. His secret police, the DDS, tortured and killed opponents and whole ethnic groups; a Chadian commission later estimated some 40,000 deaths. He fled to Senegal. Victims and activists pursued him for over twenty years, and in 2016 the Extraordinary African Chambers in Dakar, set up with the African Union, convicted him of crimes against humanity and sentenced him to life. He died in prison in 2021. See also the civil war.
sum: A northern rebel leader who took power in Chad in June 1982 and ruled until Idriss Deby overthrew him in December 1990.
